title: Sương đen
about: Round k1 of the dark ambient style (khong-gian), the first the user chose ("Không gian u tối"): D minor at 52 bpm, a dark pad held chord to chord (its tones common to two chords held across them), a deep sub under it, a low bell on the root now and then, a few bell notes far apart for a tune; the shadow of E flat (the Phrygian second) over a held D. An original piece.
